title: aide Provisioning Configuration (provisioning.yaml)
description: Shared plugin, MCP server, and hook declarations stored in ~/.config/aide/provisioning.yaml.

plugins.description: Top-level declarative plugin declarations keyed by repo path (list/null) or plugin name (string).

mcp_servers.description: Top-level MCP server definitions keyed by server name.

hooks.description: Top-level normalized agent lifecycle hooks keyed by event name.

PluginEntry.description: Plugin entry: list of plugin names (marketplace), string install reference (URL-direct), or null (declare-only marketplace).

MCPServer.description: MCP server definition (stdio command or remote URL).

command.description: Executable command for a stdio MCP server.

url.description: HTTP/SSE endpoint URL for a remote MCP server.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the command.

env.description: Environment variables for the MCP server.

name.description: Optional identifier used by per-profile exclude_hooks.

command.description: Shell command executed when the hook triggers.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (0 uses the agent driver default).
